questions.question: A Greek woman asked Jesus to free her daughter from a demon. After He spoke of the children's bread, what did she say?

answers.text: Even the dogs under the table eat the crumbs
The children are already full of bread
The dogs can wait until the next meal

questions.question: After a Greek woman answered Jesus about the children's bread, what did He tell her about her daughter?

answers.text: The demon has left your daughter
Bring your daughter here to Me
Your daughter will be well tomorrow
